CRT filter shaders in glide2x.dll

glide2x.dll contains HLSL ports of two shaders from DOSBox Staging
(https://github.com/dosbox-staging/dosbox-staging, resources/shaders/crt/):

  crt-hyllian.glsl
    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2020-2026 The DOSBox Staging Team
    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2021-2020 Hyllian <sergiogdb@gmail.com>
    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2020-2020 Tyrells
    SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
    Hyllian's CRT shader, ported from Libretro's crt-hyllian.glslp by Tyrells.
    Its mask_weights() function is by hunterk (public domain).

  vga-1080p.glsl
    SPDX-FileCopyrightText: 2020-2026 The DOSBox Staging Team
    SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT

The port (to HLSL, with fixed parameters per preset) is in src/glide2x/gl_shaders.h.
